description: Foundation: extract shared geometry and build the reusable Fingerprint. (1) Move buildGeometry() + helpers + layout constants out of src/Mandala.jsx into a new src/mandalaGeometry.js (behaviorally identical, no change to segment objects or arc `d` strings), so both Mandala and the new scrolly code share one geometry source. (2) Create src/fingerprintGeometry.js mirroring the LOCKED math in mocks/gen-scrolly.mjs, and (3) a presentational src/Fingerprint.jsx + .css used by the small-multiples grid and the profile. Independent of FEAT-002/003 in that it adds no UI wiring, but it is their prerequisite.
steps: Create src/mandalaGeometry.js. Move buildGeometry() and its helpers (showScenes, sceneSortKey, sceneGroup, sceneTypeLabel, SCENE_ORDER, SCENE_TYPE_LABELS) and the layout constants (W,H,CX,CY,INNER_R=190,OUTER_R=520,PAD_A,RING_GAP,LABEL_R,MARGIN=118,VB_X,VB_Y,VB_W,VB_H) verbatim out of src/Mandala.jsx and export them. Keep the d3 imports they need (d3-shape arc, d3-array sum/max/groups) and the scenes/shows JSON imports in the new module.

Edit src/Mandala.jsx to import buildGeometry, sceneTypeLabel, and the constants (CX,CY,VB_* etc.) from './mandalaGeometry' instead of defining them locally. Do NOT change the component body, the segment object shape, handleExport, or any hover/lock/center-readout logic. PLAYER_STATS and SCENE_COUNT_BY_SHOW may stay in Mandala.jsx or move — keep behavior identical either way.

Create src/fingerprintGeometry.js mirroring mocks/gen-scrolly.mjs: export SLOTS=['1A','1B','1C','D','2A','2B','2C','E','3s'], SLOT_LABEL ({'1A':'1A',...,'D':'GG','E':'GG','3s':'3rd'} per the mock), slotKey(code) ('4'->'D','5'->'E',/^3/->'3s', else code.trim()), byPlayerSlot (weighted sums over scenes.json keyed by player then slotKey), globalMax (max over PLAYER_ORDER x SLOTS), makeRadiusScale(R) returning d3 scaleSqrt().domain([0,globalMax]).range([R*0.12,R]), and fingerprintWedges(name,R) returning for each slot { slot, value, d (arc path from innerRadius R*0.1 to outerRadius rScale(value), startAngle i*aStep+0.03, endAngle (i+1)*aStep-0.03, aStep=2*Math.PI/9), labelX, labelY, label } plus exported hub/ring radii (hubR=R*0.1 area, ringR=R). Import d3 pieces the same way the repo does (import { arc } from 'd3-shape'; import { max } from 'd3-array'; import { scaleSqrt } from 'd3-scale').

Create src/Fingerprint.jsx + src/Fingerprint.css. Fingerprint({ name, R, labels=false, showName=false, onClick }) renders an SVG group (or standalone <svg>) with: a faint outer ring (circle r=R, stroke #ffffff, stroke-opacity 0.06), the 9 slot wedges from fingerprintWedges() filled with PLAYER_COLORS[name] at fill-opacity 0.9, a center hub dot, optional slot labels (fill INK_TOKENS.muted, font-size scaled to R) when labels=true, and an optional player-name label below when showName=true (fill INK_TOKENS.ink, bold, serif). Wedge/label geometry must match the mock. Colors only from src/palette.js. Make it usable both as a grid cell and scaled-up in the profile (accept R as the scale knob).
Optional: during dev only, drop a temporary 11-up grid of <Fingerprint> to eyeball against mocks/scrolly-grid.png, then remove it before finishing.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` exits 0 with no new errors.
src/Mandala.jsx imports geometry from src/mandalaGeometry.js and defines no duplicate copy of buildGeometry or the layout constants.

In `npm run dev` the Season Mandala renders identically to before: hover, click-to-lock (segment/player/show), live center readout, beat-group outlines, rim labels, and the Export poster PNG all work.

src/fingerprintGeometry.js fingerprintWedges('Brendan',78).map(w=>w.value) equals Brendan's per-slot weighted sums (e.g. the same numbers mocks/gen-scrolly.mjs computes from byPlayerSlot), and globalMax matches the mock.
src/Fingerprint.jsx renders a fingerprint visually matching a cell of mocks/scrolly-grid.png for a sample player.
verification: Run `npm run build` from the repo root and confirm exit code 0 (ignore the harmless chunk-size warning).
Run `npm run dev`, interact with the mandala, and trigger Export poster to confirm the PNG still downloads correctly (exportPoster.js is unchanged and must still work).
Optional: `npm run lint` passes (no new eslint errors in the new files).
findings:
DONE. `npm run build` exits 0 (only the known >500kB chunk-size warning). eslint: no new errors in any FEAT-001 file; the 13 pre-existing errors live in legacy files (ExcelParser/MasterDataParser/Stats/Timeline + two root *.js scripts) and are untouched.

Note for later FEATs: Node CLI (`node -e import('./src/..')`) cannot load these ES modules directly because they use extensionless imports (e.g. './palette') and JSON imports that only Vite resolves. Verify geometry math via a standalone script that reads src/assets/data/*.json directly (confirmed: globalMax=41.25; Brendan per-slot [1A:10.5,1B:12.5,1C:4.5,D:12,2A:16.5,2B:13,2C:8.25,E:10.25,3s:34.75]), or rely on the dev/build.

=== src/mandalaGeometry.js (new) — exports ===
Constants (numbers): W=1100, H=1100, CX=550, CY=550, INNER_R=190, OUTER_R=520, PAD_A=0.012, RING_GAP=2, LABEL_R=534, MARGIN=118, VB_X=-118, VB_Y=-118, VB_W=1336, VB_H=1336.
SCENE_ORDER (string[]), SCENE_TYPE_LABELS (object).
sceneSortKey(code)->number; sceneGroup(code)->'r1'|'gg1'|'r2'|'gg2'|'r3'|'other'; sceneTypeLabel(type)->string; showScenes(title)->[{code,round,type,parts[],total}].
buildGeometry()-> { segments, showMeta, groupBands, gridRadii, showCount }. segment object shape UNCHANGED: { id, d, player, showTitle, showIdx, sceneCode, sceneType, weight } (1043 of them). Arc paths centered at origin; render inside <g transform="translate(CX,CY)">. Mandala.jsx now imports { buildGeometry, sceneTypeLabel, CX, CY, INNER_R, VB_X, VB_Y, VB_W, VB_H } from './mandalaGeometry' and defines no duplicate geometry. PLAYER_STATS, SCENE_COUNT_BY_SHOW, DIM_OPACITY, topInitiators stayed local to Mandala.jsx. exportPoster.js unchanged; it receives view:{CX,CY,VB_X,VB_Y,VB_W,VB_H} from Mandala, same values as before.

=== src/fingerprintGeometry.js (new) — exports ===
SLOTS = ['1A','1B','1C','D','2A','2B','2C','E','3s'] (len 9).
SLOT_LABEL = {'1A':'1A','1B':'1B','1C':'1C','D':'GG','2A':'2A','2B':'2B','2C':'2C','E':'GG','3s':'3rd'}.
slotKey(code)-> '4'->'D','5'->'E',/^3/->'3s', else code.trim().
byPlayerSlot: object { [player]: { [slotKey]: weightedSum } } (module-level const).
globalMax: number = 41.25 (max over PLAYER_ORDER x SLOTS).
makeRadiusScale(R)-> d3 scaleSqrt().domain([0,globalMax]).range([R*0.12, R]).
fingerprintWedges(name, R)-> array (len 9), each { slot, value, d, labelX, labelY, label }. Wedge arc: innerRadius R*0.1, outerRadius rScale(value), startAngle i*aStep+0.03, endAngle (i+1)*aStep-0.03, aStep=2*PI/9. labelX/labelY computed at lr=R+14 (sin/-cos of wedge midangle), origin-centered.
hubR(R)-> R*0.1 (center dot radius). ringR(R)-> R (faint outer ring radius).

=== src/Fingerprint.jsx + src/Fingerprint.css (new) ===
Default export component. Props: Fingerprint({ name, R, labels=false, showName=false, onClick }).
- Renders a standalone <svg class="fingerprint"> sized width=2*(R+pad), height=top+bottom (pad=28 when labels else 12; +26 bottom when showName), with an inner <g transform="translate(cx,cy)"> where cx=R+pad, cy=R+pad.
- Draws: faint outer ring (circle r=R, stroke #ffffff, stroke-opacity 0.06), 9 wedges fill=PLAYER_COLORS[name] fill-opacity 0.9, center hub dot (r=hubR(R), same color), optional slot labels (fill INK_TOKENS.muted, font-size max(8,R*0.13)) when labels=true, optional name below (fill INK_TOKENS.ink, bold, SERIF, font-size max(12,R*0.22)) when showName=true.
- onClick (if provided) is called as onClick(name) and sets cursor:pointer.
- Colors/tokens imported ONLY from palette.js (PLAYER_COLORS, INK_TOKENS, SERIF).
Usage hint for FEAT-002/003: grid cell = <Fingerprint name R={78} onClick={...}/> (optionally showName); profile hero = <Fingerprint name R={150} labels showName/>. R is the scale knob and matches the mock (grid R=78, profile R=150). Component renders its OWN <svg>; if embedding inside an existing SVG you'll want to lift the <g> contents out or nest the svg.
